value.name: reads deed amendment aloud
value.description: Daniel reads the deed entry aloud, sounding uncertain about the house conveyance language.
evidence: he read the entry aloud in a careful, half-lawyered voice, the words about the house and its conveyance to him sounding less settled in his mouth than they did on the page

value.name: questions why amendment matters now
value.description: Daniel asks why this particular amendment needs to be discussed at this moment, revealing guarded curiosity.
evidence: he asked her why this amendment, of all of them, needed walking through now
the question carried the small, defensive lift of someone trying to learn what she already knew without admitting he wanted to

value.name: withholds answer
value.description: Asha leaves the deed list between them and does not immediately answer Daniel's question.
evidence: Asha let the deed list stay where it was between them and did not answer immediately

value.name: reveals folded pages
value.description: Asha pulls folded pages from her jacket and places them on top of the deed list, signaling she has more to show.
evidence: without explanation, she reached into her jacket and drew out the folded pages
She laid them on top of the deed list

value.name: slides pages toward Daniel
value.description: Asha smooths the pages and pushes them across the desk until they stop near Daniel's hand.
evidence: smoothed the crease once with her thumb, and slid them across the wood until they stopped just short of Daniel's hand

value.name: withdraws from document
value.description: Daniel pulls his finger away from the title line and leans back, hesitating to touch the new pages.
evidence: He withdrew his finger from the title line as if the paper had warmed under it
leaned back a fraction in the chair he had never quite settled into, and looked at the new pages without yet touching them

value.name: asks about hidden reason
value.description: Daniel asks whether there is another reason they are focusing on this document today.
evidence: "Is there some other reason we're focusing on this today?" he asked

value.name: recognizes mother's handwriting
value.description: Asha watches Daniel read the first visible line and sees him recognize their mother's handwriting, freezing in place.
